description: Pre-registered evaluation-only stress families. Each family isolates one mechanism in which a one-interval snapshot rule can be wrong and a policy with foresight can be right, and turns it up through one dose. Doses within a family share held-out tapes, so the dose response is a paired contrast. Training is unchanged; scenarios whose drivers never occur in the training curriculum are labelled out of support.

aimed_wind_front.mechanism: Wind carries the front toward the population mass. A 15-minute snapshot sees sites that are safe now but lie in the 30-60 minute path of the front.

threatened_cluster.mechanism: 60% of people in a safe cluster, 25% in a small cluster directly downwind of the fire. Largest-demand and current-danger rules serve the large cluster first; the small cluster has a deadline.

congestion_cluster.mechanism: Half the population starts in one neighbourhood. Snapshot routing prices current link speeds; installing at the densest cell funnels everyone through the same links and the jam builds over 20-40 minutes.

panic_cliff.mechanism: A wind-driven front approaches the population. Panic is a threshold loss of control; a snapshot cost is linear in current danger.

wind_shift_hedge.mechanism: A real (non-zero) wind shifts direction with 15-minute warnings that are missed 20% of the time. Snapshot rules commit to the current direction; a belief policy hedges or defers.
